content_text: If you’ve ever spent time shooting scenes against blue and greenscreens, you can understand why most cinematographers would rather have anything else! LED screens, grey screens, a painted drop, etc. It’s very hard to balance the light in a day interior — and get the ambience right — relative to the windows… when there is no view. You lose a lot of the reflectivity around the room with light bouncing around and reflecting off of surfaces when you have a big bluescreen out the window.
